title: Ensemble hub: hub.yaml
description: The hub role: the people layer beside a helper team. Embedded in one person's node, it keeps that person's knowledge vault and the models that distill it. Nothing has a default value: every setting is written, except what may be left out because leaving it out means 'not used' (`knowledge`, and a backend's `api_key_env`).

owner.description: The person this hub works for, named in everything they share.

llm_backends.description: Model endpoints the hub itself uses, such as for distilling knowledge. The key is the backend's name. Separate from the helper team's, which a company may share. `{}` when there are none.

knowledge.description: The knowledge vault, and how shares become notes. Leave it out for no knowledge.

vault.description: The vault's directory, a git repository, relative to the hub's directory or absolute. `ensemble hub init` makes it.

try.description: The models that turn shares into notes, in order. Each share uses the first whose backend answers and serves it; with one model, it is simply used. The model gets no tools: text in, text out.

when_none.description: What happens when none of the models in `try` can be used. fail: the share goes to review/, saying what each backend answered. wait: the share waits and is tried again later.

max_chars.description: Most characters one recall returns, all notes together.

llm_backend.description: How the model is reached. `type` decides which other settings there are.

api_key_env.description: The NAME of the environment variable holding the API key, sent as x-api-key. Keys are never written in this file.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds one request to this backend may take.

type.description: openai-compatible-api: any /chat/completions endpoint (llama-server, vLLM, Ollama, Unsloth, a hosted API).

base_url.description: Where the endpoint is, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1.

api_key_env.description: The NAME of the environment variable holding the API key. Keys are never written in this file. Leave it out when the endpoint wants none.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds one request to this backend may take.

model.description: The model id the endpoint serves, as its /models lists it.
